Generate a Pre-Run Privacy Coverage Report Without Leaking Raw PII

Source: R/pii.R
pii_privacy_report.Rd

Scans a character vector, data frame text column, or pseudonymized result and returns aggregate PII detection counts and document coverage rates by entity type. Raw input text and matched sensitive values are strictly excluded from the returned object.

Usage

pii_privacy_report(x, config = pii_config(), text_col = NULL)

Arguments

x

A character vector, a data frame (requiring text_col), or an airgap_pseudonymized object.

config

An pii_config() configuration object.

text_col

Character scalar column name when x is a data frame.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_privacy_report" containing only aggregate counts (n_documents, n_documents_with_pii, pct_documents_with_pii, total_entities, by_entity, config_digest, generated_at).

Examples

notes <- c("Contact Dr. Alice Smith at alice@hospital.org.", "No identifiers here.")
pii_privacy_report(notes)
#> <airgap_privacy_report> (aggregate counts only; zero raw PII)
#>   Documents scanned:  2
#>   Documents with PII: 1 (50%)
#>   Total detections:   2
#>   By entity type:
#>     - email: 1 (1 docs, 50%)
#>     - person_name: 1 (1 docs, 50%)
